topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
source_evidence: This item will appear in the prospectus fee table when the fund has agreed to reduce fees or expenses, temporarily or indefinitely. A fund may do this to attract or maintain investors. These fees or expenses may be recouped in the future.
question: What does a fee waiver or expense reimbursement indicate, and can the fund recover those waived or reimbursed amounts later?
answer: It indicates that the fund has agreed to reduce fees or expenses, either temporarily or indefinitely. The fund may later recoup those amounts, so the reduction may not be permanent.
